data.title: Science Foundations · आधारभूत विज्ञान
data.contentHtml:
How to study this chapter

Read each definition, recall it without looking, and then solve a question. These are author-created practice notes, not official past questions.

SI units

QuantityUnit
Currentampere (A)
Resistanceohm (Ω)
Forcenewton (N)
Energyjoule (J)
Powerwatt (W)

Electric circuits

Ohm’s law: V = IR. For a fixed resistance, P = V²/R. State the assumptions before applying a formula.

Waves

Period T = 1/f. Convert milliseconds and seconds before calculating.

General science

Water is H₂O. The Moon is Earth’s natural satellite. Water’s boiling temperature depends on pressure.
commonMistakes: Using 100°C as a boiling point without a pressure condition.
examTips: Write units in every numerical answer.
Reattempt incorrect questions on a later day.

data.questionText: 12 V स्रोतमा 6 Ω प्रतिरोध जोड्दा प्रवाह कति हुन्छ?
data.explanation: By Ohm’s law, I = V/R = 12/6 = 2 A.

source.title: Author-created educational practice. Verify against your prescribed textbook; not an official PYQ.

data.explanationHtml: By Ohm’s law, I = V/R = 12/6 = 2 A.

data.questionText: दुईवटा 10 Ω प्रतिरोध समानान्तर जोड्दा तुल्य प्रतिरोध कति हुन्छ?
data.explanation: For equal resistors in parallel, equivalent resistance is R/n = 5 Ω.
data.memoryTrick: Equal parallel resistors → divide by count
